summary: The filing is an 8-K by Nurix Therapeutics, Inc. disclosing a press release about updated clinical data from a Phase 1a/1b study of its BTK degrader bexobrutideg (NX-5948) in CLL/SLL patients, presented at the EHA2026 congress. The report includes safety and efficacy data but involves no corporate transaction, merger, acquisition, or structural change. It is a routine disclosure of clinical trial results under Items 7.01 and 8.01, not a special situation event. No deal terms, stake, or financial terms are provided. There is no board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory closing timeline. This filing is purely informational and not a special situation.
